next.reason: Amendment 2 (X3.23b-1993) only renumbered this rule (old GR2) and its references ('see general rule 2a' to 3a, 'in general rule 2b' to 3b). §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR3 a) 'alphabetic or alphanumeric data item' as 'a character-string', b) edited and unsigned numeric items 'inspected as though it had been redefined as alphanumeric', c) a signed numeric item moved to an unsigned one, 'the original value of the sign is retained', recur in §2023:14.9.22.4 GR4 a), b) and d). 2023 adds 'alphabetic, alphanumeric, boolean, or national data item' and c) for usage national; this rule refuses neither (§1985:VI.6.18.3 SR1 requires 'USAGE IS DISPLAY'), and every item 1985 can describe is treated the same.
